```{r}
# ── F.4 Preferred Supplemental Funding Options ────────────────────────────────

library(patchwork)

summary_data_f4 <- mlogit_clean %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(User.fee_Payment.Type != "Other (Please enter answer in the box)") %>%
  group_by(Zipverified, User.fee_Payment.Type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Zipverified) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prop  = n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Zipverified = factor(Zipverified,
                         levels = c("Resident", "Tourist"),
                         labels = c("Residents", "Tourists"))
  )

tourist_data  <- summary_data_f4 %>% filter(Zipverified == "Tourists")
resident_data <- summary_data_f4 %>% filter(Zipverified == "Residents")

custom_colors <- c(
  "Annual pass (one payment allows unlimited trail entries for a year)"     = "#6a906c",
  "Daily pass (one payment allows unlimited trail entries in a single day)" = "#ae9864",
  "Per-entry fee (pay each time you use a trail)"                           = "#503440",
  "Voluntary donation (optional payment, not required for trail entry)"     = "#535e4b"
)

p1 <- ggplot(tourist_data,
             aes(x = 2, y = prop, fill = User.fee_Payment.Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size  = 2.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(title = "Tourists", fill = "Payment Type") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p2 <- ggplot(resident_data,
             aes(x = 2, y = prop, fill = User.fee_Payment.Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size  = 2.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(title = "Residents", fill = "Payment Type") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

f4 <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "If user fee mechanisms were implemented, which payment type would you prefer?",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave(
  filename    = "Figure_F4_FundingOptions.tiff",
  plot        = f4,
  width       = 160,
  height      = 100,
  units       = "mm",
  dpi         = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_F4_FundingOptions.pdf",
  plot     = f4,
  width    = 160,
  height   = 100,
  units    = "mm"
)

print(f4)
rm(summary_data_f4, tourist_data, resident_data)
```
